Swiss made. scroll south Navigating the waters of entrepreneurship Venturelab set sail in 2004 . It began as the National Entrepreneurial Training initiative, which was mandated by the Swiss Innovation Agency to IFJ, the Institute for Young Entrepreneurs based in St. Gallen. Today, Venturelab Ltd is a fully private company supporting world-class startups, Swiss made. Since its inception, Venturelab has been improving and expanding the support offered to Switzerland's top entrepreneurs, continuously developing and deploying new tools and programs, including Venture Leaders in 2006, Venture Kick in 2007, the TOP 100 Swiss Startup Award in 2011, the Swisscom Startup Challenge in 2013, and the Innosuisse Start-up Training in 2018. To date, Venturelab has backed more than 1,000 startups in their global growth, supporting over 100,000 people in the startup ecosystem across various programs and events. Venturelab's committed team runs a broad range of impactful startup support programs in partnership with leading organizations to build world-class startups, Swiss made. Why work with us? Venturelab has an 20-year track record of developing impactful startup programs and building relationships with institutions, investors , industry experts, academics, and innovators.
Having worked with over 90% of Swiss-based startups, Venturelab has established a stellar reputation within its Swiss and international network spanning Europe, the U.S., Africa, and Asia.
Our network of partners includes well-known corporates, leading academic institutions, and globally renowned investors.
Get in touch with us for more insights about Switzerland's most promising startups and find out how we can work together.

Driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for innovation ourselves, we provide access to our global network and guide innovators from early-stage development of an idea to the growth of viable business on a global scale.

The AIT program aims to support scientists in transforming their applied research into market application and discovering their entrepreneurial potential. By connecting scientists from top ins­titutions in Switzerland, India , and Singapore the program promotes an international network and enables access to the most promising markets and intel­lectual capitals in applied research. Swiss Prime Site Start-up Accelerator Programme - Venturelab Venturelab Home Startups Programs Events Partnering About News Follow us: Linkedin / Facebook / X / Instagram / Youtube Home Startups Programs Events Partnering About News Swiss Prime Site Start-up Accelerator Program scroll south WE OFFER PERSPECTIVES As Switzerland's leading listed real estate company, Swiss Prime Site AG wants to be at the forefront of technological innovation and shape the digital transformation of the industry—together with Switzerland's most promising startups. WORKING WITH STARTUPS TO CREATE TOMORROW'S LIVING SPACES Swiss Prime Site (SPS) is the largest real estate company in Switzerland and one of the leading commercial real estate companies in Europe. The property portfolio is valued at approximately CHF 21 billion and includes own properties as well as those managed on behalf of third parties. Swiss Prime Site's own buildings, which are valued at CHF 13 billion, are concentrated in the office, retail and infrastructure segments in prime locations. The portfolio covers the densely populated regions of Zurich, Geneva and Basel, where SPS mainly owns properties in prime locations. The Asset Management business unit, Swiss Prime Site Solutions, manages assets totalling around CHF 8 billion. The product range includes open- and closed-end funds, as well as advisory services for third-party

The product range includes open- and closed-end funds, as well as advisory services for third-party investors – all with a diversified investment allocation in residential and commercial properties throughout Switzerland.

Together with its group companies Swiss Prime Site Immobilien and Swiss Prime Site Solutions , Swiss Prime Site supports innovative start-ups and cutting-edge technologies in the areas of real estate, real estate services, retail and assisted living.

AREAS OF INTEREST Swiss Prime Site reviews ideas from startups with a relevant connection to its core business or to their real estate-related group companies and which offer strategic added value to our enterprise.
Swiss Prime Site is interested in innovative concepts, scalable business models, and technological solutions in the B2B sector.
Its focus is on PropTech, Mobility, CleanTech, Big Data and Analytics, Augmented, Virtual & Mixed Reality and Fin- and RegTech.
In the context of our Accelerator Workshops, we were looking for dynamic tech start-ups offering Augmented, Mixed and Virtual Reality solutions.
When holo|one pitched their SaaS model to the jury, it quickly became clear that our experts could develop a use case with them.

The Stücki Park in Basel—where Swiss Prime Site Immobilien is constructing four new buildings for the life sciences industry and expanding the rental floor space by 33,000 m2 to over 60,000 m2—was identified as an ideal test site.
When collaborating with start-ups, Swiss Prime Site focus on expanding and developing the corporate venture ecosystem.
